BrochureContent.Content:
Set within the ever-popular Redford Park development, No 218 is a detached three-bedroom bungalow offering a wonderful balance of privacy, convenience and low-maintenance living. Nestled within a secluded enclave of just five detached bungalows, this appealing home enjoys a highly private setting while conveniently situated just minutes' walk from Greystones seafront.

This single storey home has plentiful off street car parking to the front and gated side access leads to a west-facing rear garden which provides the perfect space to relax and enjoy afternoon and evening sunshine. The low-maintenance outdoor space offers the perfect balance of convenience and privacy, benefiting from a secluded, non-overlooked aspect, while the favourable orientation is sure to appeal to gardening enthusiasts.

Beyond the entrance hall, double doors open to a spacious sitting/dining room positioned to the front of the property, where an attractive fireplace provides a focal point. To the rear, the separate kitchen is well equipped with a comprehensive range of appliances including a dishwasher, washing machine, tumble dryer, electric hob and oven. The bedroom accommodation is equally well laid out, comprising three double bedrooms, one to the front and two overlooking the rear garden, together with a fully tiled family bathroom. One of the rear bedrooms is currently utilised as a dining room, highlighting the versatility of this appealing bungalow.

The property is further enhanced by gas-fired central heating and presents an excellent opportunity for a wide range of purchasers, from downsizers seeking single-storey living to those looking to establish themselves in one of Greystones' most sought-after residential locations, close to local shops, schools, public transport and the town's renowned coastal amenities. A pedestrian short cut past St Crispin's Cell brings walkers from this property to the seafront and Marina Village in short minutes. Bursting with a wide variety of restaurants, coffee shops and boutiques and with the DART and regular bus routes bringing commuters into Dublin, Greystones residents enjoy the very best of coastal living.

Entrance Hall - 
Light filled hall, with Stira to the attic space, access to hotpress, alarm panel and double doors opening to:

Sitting / Dining Room - 3.74m x 5.78m
Generous reception to the front, with private outlook and glimpse of the sea. Feature fireplace with gas fire. Leading to:

Kitchen - 2.27m x 3.53m
Overlooking the back garden with floor and eye level units, stainless steel sink and drainer, dishwasher, washing machine, dryer. Door to garden.

Bedroom 1 - 2.45m x 3.54m
A double bedroom to the front

Bathroom - 2.45m x 2.40m
Tiled floor and walls, bath and separate electric Mira shower with glazed door. WC, pedestal wash hand basin with mirrored medicine cabinet above. Frosted window.

Bedroom 2 - 2.65m x 3.53m
Light filled double to the rear

Bedroom 3 - 2.36m x 3.53m
Currently in use as a dining room, a double bedroom to the rear.

Outside - 
Situated in a small cul de sac looking out to a mature treeline, with ample off street car parking and lawned front garden. Gated side access to a low maintenance west facing rear garden laid out in cobble block paving, path and gravel finish with wooden boundary fencing and enjoying a very high degree of privacy. Wooden garden shed.

• Small enclave of 5 detached bungalows
  • High degree of privacy both front and back
  • Gas fired central heating
  • Detached single storey living
  • West facing rear garden
  • Short walk to Marina Village
  • No management fees
